newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips fall back near opening levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips fall back near opening levels.

text.p: Wall Street stocks retreated in late afternoon, with the Dow dipping back to near its opening levels and tech stocks paring their gains.
The Dow industrials stood at 7965, up five points. Declining issues held a marginal edge on the NYSE, where volume surpassed the 500 million share mark.
The Nasdaq Composite clung to a slender gain at 1582, up six points for the session.

The afternoon activity in the U.S. stock market displayed little of the jagged action that dominated the morning session, when the Dow rose 80 points, only to tumble to a deficit of just as many points before recovering again.
